trace_count_typing: For n>=2 set P_trace_count(n)=number of newly perimeter-traced shell vertices |S_(n-1)|=6(n-1). This also equals the ordinary shell-edge count for n>=2. At n=1 the primitive invariant PERIMETER_E(CIRCLE_E(1))=1 is distinct from the singleton ordinary trace-edge count 0.
identity: A_naive(n)=|TRACE_HISTORY_CAND(n)|=|INTERIOR_CAND(n)| for every n>=1 in the existence-shell candidate arm
hidden_discrepancy: NONE: fresh-hidden and lifetime-hidden vertex contributions are identically zero, so no extra vertex-support term beyond cumulative first-time shell traces appears.
native_area_status: AREA_E(CIRCLE_E(n)) for n>=2 is not defined by this audit. The equality with vertex support cardinality is not promoted to an Enterprise area theorem.
post_hoc_formula_note: The support-count formula 1+3n(n-1) emerges here from shell counting and void-first indexing; it is not used as a membership oracle and does not license historical area interpretations without separate typing proof.
